description: This file is a shell script used for initializing development environment settings in a Visual Studio Code workspace, including configuring settings, tasks, debugging configurations, and C/C++ extension settings. It automates setup tasks such as creating config files, setting compiler and debugger paths, and configuring code analysis options.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and exits with status 1. Used for error handling in setup steps.
